trigger: Radio, late night, any night in Ch3+ (hand_radio).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Static. Then a woman's voice, very calm, very slow. No call sign.

nodes.speaker: amb_night_owl
nodes.text: This is the Night Owl. Here are tonight's names. If you know them, say them out loud where you are.

nodes.speaker: amb_night_owl
nodes.text: Dolores Paiz, Sun Valley. Marcus Webb, Sparks. Two children, unnamed, the Wells Avenue fire.

nodes.speaker: amb_night_owl
nodes.text: If you're missing someone, find a radio. I read every name I get. Goodnight. Keep each other warm.
